prompt: An eight-second vertical advertisement in one continuous centred composition. Open on deep navy as softly defocused blue circuit paths breathe and drift into sharp focus. A glass phone-call icon assembles at centre inside an expanding ring of cyan light, a voicemail waveform rippling beneath it. The word VOICEMAIL rises into the lower third, clear of the bottom edge, and stays alive there with a slow float and a gentle glow pulse. At centre the word YIDDISH pushes forward out of soft blur, drifting slowly, then blurs away and disappears completely. Only once it has gone does ENGLISH sharpen from blur in the same place, still drifting gently as the clip ends. Every change is a smooth defocus dissolve, never a cut. YIDDISH and ENGLISH never appear at the same time.
